mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (< 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5%, signaling a tight labor market, and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k/month, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500B/month, indicating strong consumer spending, drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase over a 3-month period, signaling inflation concerns, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increasing over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE below 4% with stagnant PAYEMS growth (< 100k/month) signals labor market imbalances, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains above 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1M units/month, indicating a strong housing market, always drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during strong housing markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
